text:
ashwin: Quick follow-up from last night's incident — latency spike at ~02:14 UTC burned ~4% of the weekly error budget. Root cause: autoscaler mis-scaling + heavy prefix batching from a partner job. Proposals and owners below. Asking for ack/updates by EOD PT.

oncall-bot: incident #INC-2026-0419 marked resolved (02:47 UTC).

taylor: ack. can you paste the concrete SLO delta and timeline you want?

ashwin: proposed changes — short window, low blast radius: 1) Temporarily relax p95 latency SLO from 200ms -> 250ms for 14 days; 2) Add per-route p99 alerting on tail queues; 3) Add dashboard with batch size heatmap + autoscale events; 4) Add an autoscaler unit/integration test that simulates bursty batcher.

rachel: I can own the dashboard. will add a draft in grafana and link. target: 48h.

kevin: I'll own the autoscaler change + PR. plan: add guardrail to min_replicas during partner-job windows and adjust cooldowns. PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 (WIP). ETA: tomorrow morning.

jules: I'll add the p99 alert rule and verify flapping won't generate noise. Can we get a sample of the offending traffic pattern?

ashwin: added sample logs to ticket TKT-4321 and a small replay harness: https://ci.internal/replays/4321. Use that to validate.

ashwin: adding the YAML SLO change here so the ops repo patch is reproducible:

```yaml
service: inference-api
slos:
  - name: p95_latency_ms
    target: 0.98
    window: 7d
    threshold_ms: 250  # temporary override from 200 -> 250 for 14d
    rollout: temporary
  - name: p99_latency_ms
    target: 0.995
    window: 7d
    threshold_ms: 800
```

ashwin: I'll open TKT-4321 (tracking) with owners and timeline: dashboard(rachel, 48h), autoscaler(kevin, 24h), alerts(jules, 24h), regression-tests(taylor, 72h). Will set a hard rollback to original SLO on 2026-05-03 unless action says otherwise.

taylor: I'll take regression-tests. plan: add scenario in infra-ci that replays the batcher and checks controller decisions. ETA 72h.

kevin: small note — changing min_replicas needs infra review for cost impact. I'll flag in PR and add matrics to track cost delta for the 14d window.

rachel: dashboard draft done: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd123/slo-latency-followup — sharing w/ team, please review.

jules: added alert rule draft, will tune threshold after running the replay.

ashwin: thanks all. i'll post the tracking ticket and calendar reminders. please update TKT-4321 with PR links and test results. tagging @oncall for visibility. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 48h (channel: eng-sre).
